pattern_1.transformation: Parse date from 'Collection date' using format '%m/%d/%y' in America/Denver timezone; convert to UTC. One record has a missing collection date and yields NaT.

pattern_1.source_pattern: Top sample depth_cm, Bottom sample depth_cm
pattern_1.transformation: Compute representative midpoint depth as (Top sample depth_cm + Bottom sample depth_cm) / 2. Reported as a depth range, so qc_flag='d1'.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Divide by 1e2 to convert from cm to m.

Rename 'water content %vol' to volumetric water content. Rows with no reported water content (e.g., the 50-55 cm depth increment) are dropped. A small number of physically implausible values (negative or >1 m3/m3) are retained as reported and flagged in notes for operator review.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Divide by 1e2 to convert from percent (%vol) to m3/m3.
